$comment: Windows dependencies, pinned (2026-11-05). macOS builds these from source into external/install (dependencies.md); this manifest keeps the Windows build on the same OpenColorIO 2.5 / OpenEXR 3.4 / Imath 3.2 line so a user sees the same colour maths on both platforms. The baseline is the vcpkg commit the pins were resolved against; bump it and the overrides together, and bump the macOS recipes in the same change.
